{
  "trojan_present": true,
  "trigger_condition": "The trigger activates when a 4-bit shift register (hist_reg[3:0]) that records the history of the valid-ready handshake (valid && ready) on each cycle matches the pattern 1011 (MSB first, meaning the most recent four cycles had handshake outcomes: valid-ready, no-transfer, valid-ready, valid-ready).",
  "payload_effect": "When the trigger condition is met, the payload logic forces the m_valid output low for exactly one cycle by gating it with an AND gate (payload_gate), thereby suppressing a single otherwise-valid transfer.",
  "trigger_signals": [
    "hist_reg[0]",
    "hist_reg[1]",
    "hist_reg[2]",
    "hist_reg[3]"
  ],
  "payload_signals": [
    "payload_gate"
  ],
  "confidence": 1.0
}

manifest.purpose: The golden correct answer file for the analysis_report submission. Contains all required fields: trojan_present (true), trigger_condition (exact description of the 4-cycle valid-ready history pattern 1011), payload_effect (forces m_valid low for one cycle, dropping a single valid transfer), trigger_signals (array with hist_reg[0] through hist_reg[3]), payload_signals (array with payload_gate), and confidence (1.0). This file is placed at the submission path during grading and evaluated against the hidden acceptance criteria.
